title: MoonBoard Benchmark Score Goal Adherence by Benchmark Grade
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=moonboard:session
| stats avg(benchmark_points) as actual count as sessions by benchmark_grade
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/10.0,1), goal_label="10"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average benchmark points with a simple target for each benchmark grade, showing where moonboard benchmark score is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by benchmark grade shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence benchmark grade values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of benchmark grade values with average benchmark points and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which benchmark grade settings help you hit your target for moonboard benchmark score and which ones fall short.
